map.→ 打开考勤统计报表工具: -> Open the attendance statistics report tool
map.不计入应出勤，按排班与实际上下班记录统计，系统通常自动排除。: It does not count towards required attendance; statistics follow the roster and the actual clock-in and clock-out records, and the system usually excludes it automatically.
map.加班怎么和工资联动？: How is overtime linked to pay?
map.延时加班走加班费、休息日加班可转调休，与 comp-time/overtime: Overtime on weekdays goes through overtime pay, and weekend overtime can be converted to time off in lieu, consistent with the comp-time/overtime tool.
map.异常考勤（连续迟到）标记供主管跟进。: Flags attendance anomalies (consecutive lateness) for supervisors to follow up.
map.批量导入员工每日打卡记录，统计迟到、早退、缺勤与请假天数，计算个人与团队出勤率，: Bulk-imports daily clock-in records, tallies late arrivals, early departures, absences and leave days, computes individual and team attendance rates, applies the established deduction rules to work out the pay to withhold, and generates an exportable attendance report to ease the month-end workload of HR.
map.月度出勤天数、缺勤、迟到、加班时长一键汇总成报表。: Summarise monthly attendance days, absences, late arrivals and overtime hours into a report in one click.
map.核算全勤奖与加班调休余额。: Reconcile the perfect attendance bonus and the comp-time balance from overtime.
map.法定节假日算出勤吗？: Do statutory holidays count as attendance?
map.迟到/早退统计，批量计算出勤率与应扣薪资: Late arrival / early departure statistics, computing attendance rates and pay deductions in batches
map.：某员工连续 5 天迟到，工具标红并提示谈话。: : an employee was late 5 days in a row, so the tool flags it in red and prompts a conversation.
map.：缺勤 2 天、加班 8 小时；全勤奖因缺勤取消，加班 8h 进入调休池。: : 2 days absent and 8 hours of overtime; the perfect attendance bonus is cancelled because of the absence, and the 8 overtime hours go into the time-off-in-lieu pool.
